Tom — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of your requirements
- Ingest clinical notes and structured EHR data that will include PHI.
- Throughput estimate: ~40–60 requests/sec with spikes to ~150 for batch imports.
- Data retention policy: up to 7 years for auditability.
- Compliance: must sign a BAA; SOC 2 Type II evidence required for security review.
- Deployment preference: exploring Dedicated or Private options to satisfy audit & network controls, but open to Hosted if we can meet BAA/logging requirements.

What I heard as blockers
- Need SOC 2 Type II report and BAA for procurement.
- Network isolation / VPC peering and customer KMS are required for keys in some workflows.
- Audit log granularity and retention for ePHI access.

Attachments I’m sharing (initial):
- SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (Redwood SOC 2 Type II report — redacted where necessary)
- BAA_Template_Redlines.docx (our standard BAA with some notes)
- Redwood_Deployment_Options_OV.docx (short overview: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private)

Proposed next steps
1) Please confirm procurement timeline (you mentioned end of Q3).
2) Security call: suggest a 30–45 min call with Sarah or your security team to walk the SOC2 report and controls.
3) Decision criteria: we can send a short decision checklist (hosted vs dedicated vs private) tailored to your requirements.
4) I’ll loop in Marissa for contract/procurement and Neha for deeper technical/security follow-up.

If this aligns I’ll book the security sync for next week — what windows work for Sarah’s team?

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks

Tom — great questions. Short answers up front, then details below: 

Short answers:
- SOC2: the attached SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf covers our control environment; we can provide an unredacted version under NDA if required.
- BAA: we support signing a BAA. The BAA_Template_Redlines.docx has our standard language; we’re happy to review your redlines.
- Hosted logs: by default Hosted collects operational telemetry; we can disable request/response logging for endpoints that handle PHI and enable only sampling/non-PII telemetry for SLO monitoring.
- Audit logs / retention: we support structured access logs and can export logs to your logging bucket or SIEM; retention policies can be configured to meet 7-year retention (enterprise add-on).

Options and trade-offs (high level):
1) Hosted API + BAA
   - Pros: fastest to production, lowest ops overhead, Redwood manages runtime, scales automatically.
   - Controls: BAA available; we can disable full request/response logging and enable encryption in transit + at rest. Logs can be exported to your cloud project.
   - Cons: multi-tenant control plane and shared infrastructure for management plane; some customers prefer Dedicated/Private for stricter isolation.

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity)
   - Pros: Dedicated GPU pools, predictable throughput, optional VPC peering, isolated compute nodes.
   - Controls: Customer-managed KMS for model keys, isolated compute, per-tenant logging exported to your account.
   - Cons: higher cost vs Hosted; slightly longer lead time to provision reserved capacity.

3) Private (VPC or on-prem)
   - Pros: Full network isolation, on-premise option for air-gapped environments, full control over keys and data residency.
   - Controls: We can ship with a private control plane or integrate with your private control plane, HSM/KMS integrations available.
   - Cons: highest up-front integration effort, engaged services for setup and ongoing support.

Next steps I propose:
- Security sync (30–45m) this week — Thurs 10–12 PT works for us. I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda: SOC2 walkthrough, logging/export options, BAA redlines.
- Post-sync: Neha will follow up with technical runbook for Dedicated vs Private (network diagrams, KMS flow, audit log examples).
- Contracts: Marissa will prepare a procurement outline and estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private so you can evaluate cost vs controls.

Attachments again: SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, BAA_Template_Redlines.docx, Redwood_Deployment_Options_OV.docx

Let me know if Thurs 10am PT works and we’ll lock it.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
